steps.what: Select and prescribe medications after assessing patient needs and relevant clinical risks

tasks.design: Keep medication selection and prescription with the physician using {OTHER}, the electronic patient record and prescribing system. Existing rule surveillance supports clinical checking; this design claims no replacement of clinical judgement or established baseline time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical suitability depends on incomplete, changing patient circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing medication rule checks can support the physician without becoming the prescriber.
tasks.still_hard: Urgency, uncertain history and competing treatment risks require contextual judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Balance immediate benefit and harm and take responsibility for the prescription.
tasks.altitude: Prescribing responsibility and clinical assessment time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How uncertainty and interactions affect medicine selection

evidence.claim: The G-Standaard provides interaction, contraindication, dose and duplicate medication checks; this is not evidence of autonomous prescribing or local time savings.

assumptions: Boundary is physician selection and prescription, excluding pharmacy dispensing and administration. OTHER means electronic patient record and prescribing system.

Patients, prior clinicians and available investigation services supply history and findings before or during s1. The physician verifies identity, allergies, current medicines, relevant measurements and uncertainty within its retained time; missing information requires clarification or clinical escalation rather than a free cleared-for-medication flag.
Use existing native prescribing facilities. No new automation, work transfer or added upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual prescribing system and available surveillance
research_questions: Which prescribing uncertainties remain despite existing rule surveillance?

already_counted.description: Clinical verification, selection and prescription acceptance

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient, medicine, dose, route, timing and duration prescribed; any changed order requires renewed physician acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. No separately measured copying share or new prescribing automation is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Collect and clarify patient information and capture the source note brief
Draft the medical record narrative from the captured source brief

loop.purpose: Organize a captured clinical account into the record narrative
loop.input: Physician captured note brief with attributed statements and observed findings
loop.output: Draft note linked to source passages and unresolved ambiguities
loop.check: Physician checks negation, chronology, attribution, omissions and numerical values against the brief; no inferred diagnosis or action is accepted.
loop.stop: One draft and correction pass; unclear or unreliable cases use manual documentation.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot reliably place variable clinical narrative, but native structured fields remain preferable for known values.

steps.what: Verify and commit the exact clinical note to the medical record

tasks.design: Use an approved native note-drafting facility in {OTHER}, the electronic patient record, after the physician captures and clarifies the source account. Drafting remains bounded by source evidence and physician acceptance before record write-back; collection and clinical examination effort remain counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative reorganization repeats after information collection.
tasks.enabler_now: Clinical note-drafting products exist with clinician validation.
tasks.still_hard: Misattribution, omitted negatives and changing clinical information can create a misleading record.
tasks.human_edge: Establish what actually happened and whether the note accurately represents uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: Reduce narrative composition effort while retaining source collection and record responsibility.

reach.task: Review note completeness and correction handling
reach.learn: How to preserve source attribution and record versions

evidence.claim: Autoscriber describes consultation capture followed by clinician validation and record integration.
The Capio Ramsay evaluation reports self-estimated per-note documentation time reductions with editing retained; that result does not establish emergency collection-task savings here.
The source-brief design and local labour shares are unmeasured E1 estimates.

assumptions: Boundary is collection and recording, excluding treatment decisions and independent investigations. Count overlapping examination and source collection once across related tasks; no extra savings are claimed for them.

Patients and family provide accounts and prior clinicians provide available records. During s1 the physician captures patient/encounter identity, source attribution, chronology, reported symptoms and negatives, observed findings, values/units and stated uncertainty. Its 50 hours include clarification, dictation or typing; no free transcript, structured history or permission flag is assumed. New facts after drafting return to s1 and require another review.

OTHER means electronic patient record. Test native templates and dictation before model drafting; structured values use existing fields. Unavailable approval, unreliable source capture or urgent care uses manual notes; no ambient recording is assumed.
unknowns: Approved clinical drafting access and information governance
Real capture, editing and correction time
research_questions: After counting source capture and correction, does a note draft reduce total documentation effort without important omissions?

already_counted.description: Source clarification and captured brief production
Final clinical acceptance and record commit

incremental.description: Sample omission reviews and failed-draft follow-up
Access, integration and approved template upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient and encounter, note text, attribution, measurements and source version committed; changed content voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=50+21+20=91, gross=9, focal upkeep=5, net=4. Range 0-2 allows already-efficient dictation, emergency interruptions and high correction needs; the digest case concerns note time rather than the whole collection task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Discuss treatment plans, uncertainty and responsibilities with physicians and other medical professionals

tasks.design: Retain direct professional discussion and clarification. Existing records in {OTHER}, the electronic patient record, support the conversation without an assumed separate summary-production saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Treatment discussion requires exchange of observations and different professional judgements.
tasks.enabler_now: No validated substitute for the clinical discussion or measured administrative subtask is established.
tasks.still_hard: Disagreement, urgency and uncertainty cannot be resolved by formatting a plan.
tasks.human_edge: Surface concerns, reconcile perspectives and check that colleagues understand responsibility.
tasks.altitude: The physician retains the full discussion time.

reach.task: Discuss a treatment plan and escalation needs
reach.learn: Which practical care constraints require explicit clarification

evidence.claim: Clinical plan discussion involves reciprocal professional judgement; no local labour reduction is established.

assumptions: Boundary is clinical discussion, excluding original examination, independent colleague work and treatment execution.

The physician brings available findings; colleagues produce their responses during s1 before discussion closes. Clarification and any existing recording remain in retained time; no free agreed-plan or accepted-handoff flag is assumed.
Use existing record access and communication facilities first. No new tool or work transfer is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Actual causes of repeated clinical discussion
research_questions: Which repeated discussions concern missing source information rather than necessary clinical deliberation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Necessary professional discussion retains its time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Identify patient factors, communication barriers and underlying disease relevant to management

tasks.design: Keep contextual assessment with the physician and use {OTHER}, the electronic patient record, as a source. Do not turn demographic fields or a record summary into an automatic patient-management conclusion.
tasks.previous_blocker: A factor's relevance depends on this patient and the immediate clinical situation.
tasks.enabler_now: Record access supports assessment but establishes no independent judgement-time saving.
tasks.still_hard: Unreported disease and communication barriers may become apparent only through interaction.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize uncertainty and adapt the interaction to establish what matters clinically.
tasks.altitude: Management assessment and its source clarification remain physician work.

reach.learn: How access needs differ from assumptions based on demographics

evidence.claim: Patient management factors require contextual interpretation; a structured demographic field does not establish clinical relevance.

assumptions: Boundary is identifying management-relevant factors, excluding separate recording, treatment selection and specialist assessment. Overlapping source collection is assigned once.

Patients, family and prior clinicians provide circumstances and history before or during s1. The physician checks current relevance and communication needs within retained time; uncertainty remains explicit rather than becoming a free risk or communication-capability flag. OTHER means electronic patient record.
Use native record access first. No new system, delegated capture or added maintenance is proposed.
unknowns: Availability of appropriate interpretation and communication support
research_questions: Which management factors are missed despite current record access and patient discussion?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Contextual judgement retains its time; no separate record abstraction baseline is invented.
